question: Which of CoCoRaHS's inputs (observers, approved gauge and its makers, website/app/hosting, NWS offices and coordinators) faced decline, disruption, end of supply or news about these between January 2024 and November 2026, and what could replace them or CoCoRaHS's data (COOP, mesonets, radar-gauge products)? How does each input rate (imminent, emerging or no current threat), and does each finding support or contradict DIRS-1, DIRS-2, DIRS-3 and DIRS-5?
searched_on: How many observers and stations are there by year and state, how well does CoCoRaHS recruit and keep them, and do the counts agree with GHCN-Daily's station turnover?
Which gauges are approved, who makes them, and was their supply steady in 2024-2026?
What runs the website, data entry and mobile apps, and where are they hosted?
Which NWS offices and state and county coordinators recruit and train observers?
